summary: Describes a system deployed by the ISP Comcast to deliver critical notifications to customers' web browsers, for example warning that their traffic looks like malware infection. It documents one provider's design and its status is historic.

eli5.summary: An internet company wanted a way to pop up a warning on your web browser, like a note on your door, if your computer seemed to be sick.

questions: how can an isp warn customers about malware in the browser
